name: recordist
title: Recordist
description: Search your Recordist meetings, start and stop recordings, and add markers, right from Raycast. Requires the Recordist app to be running.
author: recordist

commands.name: search-meetings
commands.title: Search Meetings
commands.subtitle: Recordist
commands.description: Find a meeting by what was said, and read its summary, decisions and action items.

commands.name: start-recording
commands.title: Start Recording
commands.subtitle: Recordist
commands.description: Start a recording, or bring up Recordist's card to ask first, as you set it in Recordist.

preferences.name: alwaysAsk
preferences.title: Asking First
preferences.label: Always show Recordist's card before recording
preferences.description: Recordist asks with its own card, and nothing records until you answer it there. Without this, the command starts at once when Recordist allows other programs to start recordings.

commands.name: stop-recording
commands.title: Stop Recording
commands.subtitle: Recordist
commands.description: Stop the recording, and let Recordist write it up.

commands.name: add-marker
commands.title: Add Marker
commands.subtitle: Recordist
commands.description: Mark this moment in the recording, with an optional label.

commands.name: open-recordist
commands.title: Open Recordist
commands.subtitle: Recordist
commands.description: Bring Recordist to the front, or open its download page if it is not installed.

preferences.name: apiToken
preferences.title: Token
preferences.description: Leave empty to use the token Recordist keeps for your own tools. Or paste a token from Recordist: Settings, Integrations, New token for another program.
